source: Lets build a 3d game that is a arcade where the user can choose from a few arcade games to play from a menu then use a first person camera from afar to be able to play the game thru UI buttons watching the 3d model of the arcade game. First lets start with an pinball machine and build the game from there. This should feel as realistic as possible.

image_prompt.text: The pinball machine as the focal object of the room, placed and lit so it reads as the thing you came for
Clear floor space around the machine so a player can walk up to it and stand back from it
Composed vantage points in the arcade
A handful of other arcade cabinets around the room, so there is more than one game to pick from

notes: No genre fits: the layout job is an arcade interior, but the gameplay happens inside a machine model driven by UI buttons, not in the space.
Interior-only enclosure; single zone to start, since the user asked to begin with one pinball machine and build out.
'As realistic as possible' is a rendering constraint on the whole build, not an option.

open_questions.ask: Do you walk around the arcade to reach a machine, or does choosing from the menu put you straight in front of it?
How many cabinets should the room hold, and should the others be playable later or just set dressing?
Is this a single room, or an arcade floor you move through?

theme: Photoreal modern arcade interior - grounded materials, warm cabinet lighting, no stylization

coverage_missing.ask: Is the arcade itself walkable, or only a backdrop to the machine?
How many cabinets, and which games are they?
One room or a larger arcade floor?
A modern arcade, or a period one - eighties neon, say?

answers.ask: Do you walk around the arcade to reach a machine, or does choosing from the menu put you straight in front of it?
answers.answer: Choosing the pinball game from the menu should place the player straight in front of its machine; no walking is needed for this first build.

answers.ask: How many cabinets should the room hold, and should the others be playable later or just set dressing?
answers.answer: Keep the room small with the single playable pinball machine for now; additional arcade cabinets can be simple set dressing and are not playable in this build.

answers.ask: Is this a single room, or an arcade floor you move through?
answers.answer: Make it a single small arcade room, since the player selects the game from a menu rather than moving through an arcade floor.
